rationale_evidence.anchor: the closest real-world analog of the CAPPI fallback risk is not in any system's code but in the P3-F1 incident: an unread evidence artifact was declared 'not needed' — a silent epistemic-status change.

This is topical/evidentiary overlap (two efforts drawing on the same underlying migration-plan facts), not a stated claim that one label IS, EXTENDS, or IS DERIVED-FROM the other -- no SOURCE-CLAIMED-* row names the other label as target. Per the protocol, same-document/same-row co-occurrence is explicitly listed as insufficient alone.
p3a_pairs.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row in either family stating e.g. 'the durability-ADR program (b) was commissioned because of stage3's P3-F1/P3-F2 findings (a)' or similar explicit causal/lineage language would upgrade this to DERIVED-FROM with basis SOURCE-CLAIMED-ONLY or CORROBORATED.
